# Thrill Factory

> The Shivpuri Thrill Factory is an adventure and entertainment park in Shivpuri, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand.

Guests come for bungee jumping, giant swing, reverse bungee, SCAD jump, rope bungee, zip line, indoor games, VR, and a kids zone. The park is open every day from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM. The desk is near the Indian Oil petrol pump and DGBR, Shivpuri, Devprayag Road, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand 249192. Call +91 89299 42009 or +91 89299 42005, or email info@thrillfactory.in.
